title: Ashik Totem
description: This resource pack replace Totem Of Undying with Gold Ashik!
body:
Do you like Ashik? But there is no resource pack, that can replace your totem with **THAT JUICY Ashik?** Well... THERE IS!

<details>
<summary>Official?</summary>

It's an official resource pack from XCrier Devs, so dont be scared (There is no virus in it) (Or is it?)

</details>



This resource pack replaces old Totem of Undying with a Golden Ashik, from the indie game XCrier!

XCrier (Main Game): [linke](https://kvatper.itch.io/xcrier)
